mapper.insert: INSERT INTO domain_outbox (outbox_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status, created_at, sent_at) VALUES (#{outboxId}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{sentAt})
mapper.select: SELECT outbox_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status, created_at, sent_at FROM domain_outbox WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT #{limit}
